label: Sender Alignment
description: Support thread with sender alignment. Best for a Card with an avatar and name header over a thread mapped from data, each turn announcing its sender to screen readers.

label: All Variants
description: Bubble variants in a release thread. Best for one turn per variant, from a secondary status update and a destructive failure notice to the full width ghost answer.

label: Grouped Messages
description: Grouped consecutive messages. Best for sender entries holding an array of lines, a wider thread gap than group gap, and a delivered time under the last turn.

label: Reactions
description: Message reactions and a reaction button. Best for emoji pills hanging off the bubble edge, each named for screen readers, and a button that adds yours.

label: Show More
description: Long reply with show more. Best for a lead line kept visible and the rest opened on request, the button's chevron turning with it.

label: Quick Replies
description: Quick reply bubbles. Best for choices that swap for the echoed pick and a reply written for that option, with a way to start over.

label: Formatted Answer
description: Assistant answer with formatted content. Best for an answer across the row as real elements (a heading, a list, code), with no markdown parser.
